title: Vioverse v1.0 — Moonlit Royal Interface
notes: Massive reference-inspired overhaul across all tabs: illustrated moonlit forest backdrop without ghost UI, luxury fantasy typography, ornate companion frames and unique rarity art, Characters/Gathering/Inventory/Missions/Gacha/Shop screens, expedition storytelling and discovery gallery. Fixed portrait-to-skill-tree flashing with an in-place face swap. Stable scrolling, browser save compatibility and automatic five-second update checks remain.
